title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Farafara kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya
bridge: Sipanikɛ, kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la, I subjonctif ka denw b'a farafara k'a dɛmɛ don I dɔgɔrakɛw ka denw b'a farafara. Angalɛnkan, I subjonctif tɛ I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la, o b'a farafara sira; I dɔgɔrakɛw be I modali dɔw b'a farafara. Tɛmɛna, 'no creo que sea correcto' ka kunna 'I don't think it is right' (tɛ 'it be right'). Kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la, 'should' dɔ 'would' ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya tɛ a farafara sipanikɛ la, I kondisionali ka denw b'a farafara. Dɔgɔrakɛw ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la, I adverbew ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya dɔ I negasiyɔn ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya tɛ a farafara.
rule: Angalɛnkan kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la, B2 ka tɔgɔ la, I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya wɛrɛw bɛɛ dun: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + I dɔgɔrakɛw ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya: 'I think that...' (tɛ I subjonctif). 2) I modaliw: 'should' (kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya), 'ought to' (fɔlɔnkan), 'must' (kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya tɔrɔ), 'can't' (tɛ I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya), 'could' (I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya tɛ a farafara), 'would' (I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya). 3) I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) I kondisionalew I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya la: 'If we allowed... , then...' (I kondisionali kɔrɔtan), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (I kondisionali karantan). 5) I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. I negasiyɔn ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya tɛ a farafara ('I don't agree with nothing' tɛ I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya) dɔ I inversiyɔn ka kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: N bɛɛ n'a taara n ka fɔlɔ I testeyisɛw ka taa jati fɛ, fɔlɔ o tɛ bɛɛ I kɛlɛya jɛn-jɛniw kanbaya.

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la
bridge: Espagnol kan, i sira dɔgɔsu subjonctif la don kɛ i ka kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la (''quisiera'', ''me gustaría''), gɛlɛn fɛ, anglais kan, i kɛ modaux dɔw kɛ ''would'', ''could'' kɛ ''might'' mɛn ma kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, nka, a bɛɛ kan structurɛ wɛrɛ gɛlɛya. A fɛ, espagnol kanbaya jamana bɛɛ, i bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la jɔn ka tɛmɛ dɔrɔn, gɛlɛn fɛ, anglais kan, i dɛmɛ ''no'' ka taa jɔn sira kɛ frafra dɔw kɛ ''I'm afraid'' wala ''unfortunately''. Ala ko i tɛna ''de acuerdo'' ka taa jɔn sira kɛ ''I am agree''- fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, verbe wɛrɛyɛlɔ bɛɛ yɛ ''agree'' an ka tɛ ''agree'' kɛ ''to be'' sɛbɛn.
rule: Anglais kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, modaux bɛɛ i ka kan (would, could, might, may) kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la kɛ frafra dɔw. ''I would suggest...'' wala ''We could consider...'' bɛɛ yɛ i taara bɛɛ kan ''I want...'' wala ''You must...''. Ala ko i bɛna kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, ''What if...'' wala ''How about...'' bɛɛ i taara bɛɛ kan gerundif wala clause. Ala ko i bɛna kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, frafra dɔw bɛɛ i taara bɛɛ kan ''I see your point, but...'' wala ''I'm afraid that...''. Ala ko i bɛna kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, conditionnel bɛɛ i taara bɛɛ kan (If... then...). Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, anglais kan, ''agree'' bɛɛ yɛ verbe an ka tɛ adjectif, nka, ''I am agree'' bɛɛ tɛna ''I agree''.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.

concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, espagnol kan, i bɛna ''estoy de acuerdo'' (verbe ''estar'' + nom), nka, i bɛna ''I am agree'' anglais kan. Gɛlɛn fɛ, anglais kan, ''agree'' bɛɛ yɛ verbe wɛrɛyɛlɔ, nka, i tɛna ''to be'' sɛbɛn. Ala ko i bɛna kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la, fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, ''agree'' bɛɛ yɛ ''coincidir'' wala ''estar de acuerdo'' an ka tɛ ''be'' sɛbɛn. A fɛ, adverb dɔw bɛɛ i taara bɛɛ kan ''completely'' wala ''partially'' kɛlɛ i ka kanbaya kɛ fɛnkɛrɛw la.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw
bridge: A ka kɛ, kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu, i tun tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu, o b'a yira k'a kanu 'I found it...' an ka 'It struck me as...', n'a tun tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu, mɛn ko i ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'me pareció' an ka 'me resultó'. Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu, i ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu (a gripping novel), mɛn ko kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu (una novela apasionante). Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu: kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu tun tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu (the protagonist discovers...), mɛn ko kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanu ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu.
rule: Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu a ka B2 tɔgɔ, i tun tɛ ka kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu: 1) Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'I found it + adjetivo' (I found it thought-provoking) an ka 'It struck me as + adjetivo' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu (I read the book last year). 4) Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'unlike' an ka 'whereas' (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'based on' (The movie is based on a novel). Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu, adjetivos 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' bɛɛ kanu. Kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'me pareció' tɛ ka 'it seemed to me' kɔrɔni; kɛlɛya kelen kɔfɛ kanw ka sɔrɔ dɔgɔbaw kanu 'I thought' an ka 'I found'.

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Kaɲukanw bɛɛkɛ minkɛ fɛɛnw kɔrɔmani
bridge: Espaɲɛ kan, mɔgɔ min bɛ kaɲukanw bɛɛkɛ minkɛ fɛɛnw kɔrɔmani wala jɔnw bɛɛkɛw la, i sɔrɔ indicativo tɛ presentɛ la. A maa, angɛlɛ kan, present perfect bɛ yɔrɔ a ka kɔrɔ la don i jaabi presentɛ la (Researchers have found...). Kɔfɛ la, simple past bɛ yɔrɔ fɛɛnw ka kɔrɔw la (The study showed...). Kɔfɛ fana, angɛlɛ kan, modal verbs wɛrɛ e ka may, might, could bɛ yɔrɔ mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la. Espaɲɛ kan, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka puede wala mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la. Kɔfɛ fana, however wala although bɛ yɔrɔ kaɲukanw ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la, espaɲɛ kan sin embargo wala aunque bɛ yɔrɔ a ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la, amma i ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ sira kelenya bɛrɛ.
rule: Kaɲukanw bɛɛkɛ minkɛ fɛɛnw kɔrɔmani wala jɔnw bɛɛkɛw la angɛlɛ kan, B2 tɛmɛ la, ɔriganizɛ woto sɛbɛn: 1) Present perfect bɛ yɔrɔ fɛɛnw ka kɔrɔw la i jaabi presentɛ la: 'Scientists have discovered a new vaccine' (I ka jɔn ka kɛlɛ...), kɔfɛ simple past bɛ yɔrɔ fɛɛnw ka kɔrɔw la i tun: 'The study was published in 2020'. 2) Passive voice bɛ yɔrɔ kɔrɔmani wala jɔnw bɛɛkɛw la, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka kɔrɔ la wala mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka jamana bɛɛ la sɔrɔ: 'The drug is being tested' (Dɔgɔtɔgɔn bɛɛkɛ bɛ yɔrɔ i ka jɔn). 3) Modal verbs wɛrɛ e ka may, might, could bɛ yɔrɔ mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la: 'This could lead to new treatments' (A ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ ka kɔrɔsi kɛra jɔnw bɛɛkɛw ye). 4) Conectors wɛrɛ e ka however (nee sin embargo), although (nee aunque), despite (nee a pesar de), i ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la (although + mɔgɔ + ɛndɛ, wala despite + tɛmɛ wala -ing). 5) Akademikɛ wala jɔn bɛɛkɛw ka dumaw: 'evidence', 'findings', 'symptoms', 'treatment', 'effective' wala 'efficient'. Fila ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ la, angɛlɛ kan, relative pronouns bɛ yɔrɔ: 'The patient whom the doctor treated...' (Mɔgɔ min dokɔtɔrɔ ka kanu...). Fɛɛnw ka tɔgɔ wala pɔsɛntajiw ka taa jati fana i ka taa ka jamana bɛɛ bɛɛ kanu.

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Kɛlɛyaɲu politiki ɛkɛlɛmuyaɲu kɔfɛ
bridge: A taali gi, i kɛlɛyaɲu politiki ɛkɛ kanbayaɲu kɔfɛw la, an bena a subjonkti ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("Il est important que nous votions"). A lɔnnikɛlaw la, kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("It's important that we vote"). Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("It's important that we vote"). Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("It's important that we vote"). Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("It's important that we vote"). Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu don an ka ɛlɛmɔw ka jamana ka tɛmɛ a ka filimu ("It's important that we vote").
rule: Kɛlɛyaɲu politiki ɛkɛ kanbayaɲu kɔfɛw la, a B2 tɔgɔ la, a yɛrɛ fana ka tɛmɛ: 1) A 'subjonkti ka kɛlɛyaɲu' kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'It's essential that the government act now'. A kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'It's essential that the government act now'. 2) Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu 'when', 'if' ɛkɛ kondisɔnɛliw: an bena a kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu (present simple) a ka ɛmɛ kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu: 'When the election happens, we'll know the results'. 3) Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu ɛmɛ kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu: 'I strongly believe', 'I'm afraid I disagree', 'that's a valid point, but...'. 4) A 'though' ka kɛlɛyaɲu a ka ɛmɛ kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu: 'The policy seems good, though it's expensive'. 5) Kɛlɛyaɲu kɛlɛw bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛyaɲu: 'politics' a yɛrɛ fana ka tɛmɛ; 'policy' a yɛrɛ fana ka tɛmɛ. A taali gi, 'politika' a yɛrɛ fana ka tɛmɛ, mɛn ko i ka tɛmɛw ka tɔgɔ.

title: Expressing Abstract Ideas and Nuance / Afa kaɲaŋ ni aɲi sababu kaɲaŋ
bridge: A talifu sɛbɛn, i ka afa kaɲaŋ ni aɲi sababu kaɲaŋ kanw fɔlɔ subjuntiivu ni fɔlɔ dumuni tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔn 'es posible que' wala 'me parece que'. A anglesɛn, maa ni kɛ fɔlɔ ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ ni aɲi sababu kaɲaŋ wala maa ni kɛ fɔlɔ ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ jɛn futuru kɛ, i ka dumuni dumani modali ni dumuni impersonɛl kanw fɔlɔ, nka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔn. Lafiliw bɛɛ, i kɛ fɔlɔ ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ subjuntiivu kanw fɔlɔ a anglesɛn, nka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ, hayi i kɛ fɔlɔ ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ aɲi sababu wala aɲi fɔlɔ kɛ an ka dumuni dumani kaɲaŋ tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔn. O fɛɛrɛw la, o taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ dumuni tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔn 'actualmente' (actually) wala 'realizar' (to realize).
rule:
Maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ afa kaɲaŋ kaɲaŋ a anglesɛn kanu bɛɛ, a ka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ:
1. Dumani modali maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ deduksii ni espɛkulasi: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'must', 'can't'. Tɛmɛtɛmɛw: "She might be right" (A ka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ aɲi fɔlɔ kɛra a ka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ) - aɲi fɔlɔ kɛra a ka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ modali kanw fɔlɔ, hayi subjuntiivu kanw fɔlɔ.
2. Dumuni impersonɛl fɔlɔ 'it': "It seems that...", "It is said that...", "It is believed that...". A talifu sɛbɛn, i ka dumuni dumani 'se dice', 'se cree', a anglesɛn, i ka dumuni dumani impersonɛl pasiivu kanw fɔlɔ.
3. Dumani advɛrbiu maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ evidɛnsi: 'apparently', 'presumably', 'totally', 'completely' maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ aɲi sababu kaɲaŋ.
4. Aɲi fɔlɔ kɛra a ka taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ 'actually' (a tɛmɛyaɲu) ni 'currently' (a tun). 'Realize' a kɛra afa kaɲaŋ 'darse cuenta', hayi 'realizar'.
5. Maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ opii: 'I would argue that...', 'I tend to think that...', 'From my perspective...'.
6. O taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ dumuni 'suggest' ni 'recommend' + that + dumuni bɛɛ (subjuntiivu taa kɛra afa kaɲaŋ tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔn): "I suggest that he go" (hayi 'goes').
7. Dumani kondisii 'would' maa ni kɛ afa kaɲaŋ ipɔtɛzi: "If I were you, I would..."

title: Discussing Art and Culture / Faranw dɔgɔkunw kɛ jamana kanbɔra
bridge: Espagnol kan, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka kɛ faranw dɔgɔkunw ka kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani kɛ ka jamana kanbɔra filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani. A maa sira ka tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani (A bɛɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ...?). Anglikan, 'present perfect' (have seen) bɛ se ka tɛmɛ jumanw lo kɛ ka jamana kanbɔra filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani, amma 'past simple' bɛ se ka tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani. Faranw fɛ, anglikan, sɛbɛn fɛnna (amazing, stunning) bɛ se kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani kɛ ka jamana kanbɔra filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani, amma sɛbɛn fɛnna ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ bɛ se ka tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani: anglikan, 'a beautiful old painting' bɛ se ka tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ 'an old beautiful painting'. Kɛlɛya, anglikan, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka 'the' ka kɛ kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani kɛ ka jamana kanbɔra filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani, amma espagnol kan, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka 'the' ka kɛ kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani kɛ ka jamana kanbɔra filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani.
rule:
Faranw dɔgɔkunw kɛ jamana kanbɔra ka kɛ anglikan kan B2 la, i tɛmɛna:
- Kɔrɔ filimujɛnkɔlɔ kɔrɔmani ka kɛ 'present simple': 'The painting depicts...'
- Tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ 'present perfect': 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Tɛmɛ jumanw lo ka kɛ 'past simple': 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Sɛbɛn fɛnna: sɛbɛn fɛnna ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ (sɛbɛn fɛnna, sɛbɛn fɛnna, sɛbɛn fɛnna, sɛbɛn fɛnna, sɛbɛn fɛnna) kɛ 'so' kɛ 'such' ka kɛ sɛbɛn fɛnna.
- Sɛbɛn fɛnna: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Verbos modales ka kɛ sɛbɛn fɛnna: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

title: Problem-solving discussions / Kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw
bridge: Aspanyakan, kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye, i tun mògòw ka kanbirew subjonctif nò fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye, a tè fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. A tè angalekanan, i tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye, a tè fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. Kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye, i tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye, a tè fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. A tè angalekanan, i tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye, a tè fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye.
rule:
A tè angale, kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye, i tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye: 
1. **Kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye** (hipotetik): 'If + passé simple, would + verbe base'. Karanga: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' I tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. 
2. **Kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye** (passé hipotetik): 'If + past perfect, would have + participe'. Karanga: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' I tun mògòw ka kanbirew fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. 
3. **Fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + verbe base. 'Had better' ye fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye. 
4. **Fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye**: 'What about...?', 'How about...?', 'Why don't we...?', 'Could we...?', 'Maybe we should...'. 
5. **Fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye**: 'On the one hand... on the other hand...', 'The advantage is...', 'The downside is...', 'It might work because...'. 
6. **Fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye**: 'I see your point, but...', 'That sounds reasonable, however...', 'I'm not convinced that...'. 
Sòrò fòlòw fanga ka kàn mògòw kelen ye (kilan fiman fòkòlòwòrènw ye).

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Kɛlɛya k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kanu
bridge: Espagnol kan, i sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun ani a b’an tɛmɛ a b’an ka k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun. K’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun, i sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun ani a b’an tɛmɛ a b’an ka k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun. K’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun, i sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun ani a b’an tɛmɛ a b’an ka k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun.
rule: K’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun, i sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun ani a b’an tɛmɛ a b’an ka k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun: 1) 'be going to + infinitivo' k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun (I’m going to start a business). 2) 'will + infinitivo' k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun (I’ll do my best). 3) 'would like + infinitivo' ani 'would love + infinitivo' k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun (I’d like to improve my English). 4) Verbos como 'hope', 'plan', 'intend', 'expect' k’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun (I hope to travel, I plan to save money). 5) Expresiones con gerundio tras preposiciones: 'look forward to + -ing', 'be interested in + -ing'. 6) El primer condicional para metas condicionadas: 'If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam'. K’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun: omitir el 'to' en infinitivos, usar infinitivo tras preposiciones (correcto: 'I’m good at learning'), y confundir 'will' con el presente para hablar de planes fijos. K’a sira dɔgɔbaw kan kɛlɛya n’a tun, 'hope' puede ir seguido de presente simple para futuro (I hope I get the job).
